rule: each directive must be consumed by an error on exactly its intended line

negatives.reason: A queue add carries no account pin.
negatives.text: const pinned: JobInvocation<JobOf<"queueAdd">> = { job: { kind: "queueAdd" }, acct: services.page }

negatives.reason: Undo requires the branded queue entry, never a video ID.
negatives.text: const byVideo: JobInvocation<JobOf<"queueUndo">> = { job: { kind: "queueUndo", listId, videoId: "AAAAAAAAAAA" } }

negatives.reason: Undo needs the list and entry identities, not plain strings.
negatives.text: const unbranded: JobInvocation<JobOf<"queueUndo">> = { job: { kind: "queueUndo", listId: "list", setVideoId: "entry" } }

negatives.reason: The overlay has no per-card or speculative slot.
Labels come from the five states.
A titled queue message requires its title.
Simple queue labels take no values.
A failed outcome cannot claim confirmation.
negatives.text: const claimed: QueueOutcome = { kind: "failed", reason: "unavailable", quiet: true, entry: null }
